item.title: Europe Travel Guide Blog Writer
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m expanding my travel blog with a dedicated series of destination guides that spotlight Europe’s most intriguing cities, towns, and hidden gems. For each location I’ll need a well-researched, SEO-ready article that feels both authoritative and inspiring—something readers can consult on their phones while wandering cobblestone streets.
Scope of the work You’ll choose or be assigned a European destination, dig into reliable sources (tourism boards, local blogs, recent news), and craft a 1,500–2,000-word guide. The piece should open with a concise overview, then flow naturally through must-see sights, food and nightlife highlights, transport options, estimated costs, and seasonal tips. A conversational tone is essential; think helpful friend rather than brochure copy.
SEO & formatting Please weave in primary and secondary keywords, write a meta description, and use logical H2/H3 headings so the post drops straight into WordPress without heavy reformatting. Internal link suggestions to existing posts and a handful of authoritative external links will round it out.
Deliverables and acceptance • One Google Doc or Word file per destination • Keyword list + meta description pasted at the top • Royalty-free images (at least two) with attribution or source links • Grammarly-checked, plagiarism-free text ready for publication
If you love Europe and have a knack for turning research into engaging storytelling, I’d love to see a sample of your previous travel writing—especially any destination guides you’ve produced.

item.title: Web Designer Needed: HIPAA-Compliant Squarespace Site & Acuity Scheduling Setup for Laboratory
item.description:
250-750 USD | Overview:
I am seeking an experienced web designer to build out a clean, modern, and formal website for a clinical pathology laboratory. We have an existing domain and an inactive Squarespace account. The primary goal is to launch a professional web presence that features seamless, HIPAA-compliant patient scheduling.
Scope of Work:
Page Builds & Design: Custom layout and configuration for a small site, including a Services page (detailing testing capabilities) and an About Us page (mission statement, team bios, and photos for 4 staff members).
HIPAA-Compliant Scheduling Integration: Set up and embed Acuity Scheduling into the site. Must support a seamless booking flow that matches brand styling while ensuring all Protected Health Information (PHI) is safely captured within Acuity. (Note: Must be configured on an Acuity tier that supports a signed BAA).
Design & Responsiveness: Clean, uncluttered layout with modern healthcare typography and a restrained color palette. Fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers (Chrome, Safari, Edge).
Deliverables:
Fully configured and published Squarespace (or other) website.
Integrated, end-to-end tested Acuity Scheduler meeting all HIPAA requirements.
A brief hand-off guide (PDF or Doc) so internal staff can update copy, add services, and manage appointments moving forward.
Client Support:
Logo collaborator access to Squarespace/Acuity (if used) will be provided upon project kickoff.

item.title: Landscape App Development
item.description:
250-750 USD | I'm seeking a skilled developer to enhance my web-based app for my landscape company. The goal is to streamline and improve several key functionalities.
Key areas for development: - Client management: Efficiently track and manage client information and interactions. - Scheduling and task management: Organize and allocate tasks seamlessly. - Invoicing and payment processing: Simplify financial transactions.
Integration is crucial with: - Accounting software: To maintain accurate financial records. - Customer Relationship Management (CRM): To manage client relationships effectively. - Payment gateways: To facilitate secure and easy payments.
The app must be optimized for both desktop and mobile platforms.
Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proven experience in web app development. - Strong background in integrating accounting software, CRMs, and payment gateways. - Expertise in creating user-friendly interfaces for both desktop and mobile devices. - Familiarity with the landscaping industry is a plus, but not required.
Looking for a developer who can deliver a robust, efficient, and user-friendly solution within my budget.

item.title: WordPress User Activity Dashboard
item.description:
25-50 CAD/hr | I want to see at a glance how people actually use my WordPress site, so I need a Looker Studio (formerly Google Data Studio) dashboard that pulls real-time user activity directly from the WordPress database or an appropriate plugin/API.
The focus is on three metrics: - time duration per session that a user logs in (session start/end time). Or if not possible, then total amount of time that a user uses the site, across all times that they’ve logged in. - page view (yes/no) - this will allow us to see which module they got to, and how far within that module. - file downloads
Please visualise the trends with simple bar or line charts and pair them with clean, sortable data tables for quick exporting. A date-range selector and user search filter should sit at the top so I can drill down without editing the report. Responsive layout is important because I will view it on both desktop and tablet.
Deliverables 1. Reliable data connection from WordPress to Looker Studio (native connector, BigQuery, or a lightweight middleware—whatever you recommend and set up). 2. One-page dashboard containing the charts and tables described above, styled to match my site colours. 3. Brief hand-over note explaining how to refresh data sources and add additional metrics later.
I will supply admin access to WordPress and a Google account for Looker Studio as soon as we agree on the approach.

item.title: Shopify Store Setup & Branding
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | My goal is to turn a blank Shopify account into a polished, on-brand storefront that consistently reinforces who we are and why visitors should remember us. The primary focus is brand awareness, so every visual and functional decision—from theme selection to homepage layout—has to serve that objective.
I haven’t settled on a theme yet and need guidance finding one that can be customised without sacrificing performance. Once the theme is chosen, I’ll rely on you to install it, tailor the colour palette, typography and imagery to match our style guide, and configure core pages (home, product, about, contact) so the narrative feels cohesive.
Key deliverables • Curate and recommend 2-3 suitable Shopify themes, explaining the pros and cons of each for brand-building. • Customise the chosen theme (logo placement, colours, fonts, section order, navigation). • Set up essential Shopify settings: payment gateways, shipping profiles and basic SEO metadata. • Integrate at least one brand-amplifying touchpoint—this could be a blog module, testimonial slider or social media feed, whichever best fits the theme’s structure. • Provide a brief hand-off guide (video or PDF) so I can manage routine updates confidently.
Acceptance criteria The store should load quickly on mobile and desktop, display consistent branding across all pages, and pass Shopify’s theme check without errors. I’ll consider the project complete once the storefront is live under my domain and I can add a new product or blog post unaided using your guide.

item.title: Musician Site Usability Revamp
item.description:
250-750 USD | This is a job for my client/friend. His Wix website is the hub for fans to discover his music, buy records and keep up with shows, yet it currently feels clunky. This refresh is all about usability—first and foremost I need the navigation and the overall look-and-feel simplified so visitors can find music, merch and tour dates in as few clicks as possible.
Visual priorities The layout design needs a rethink: clearer content hierarchy, balanced white space and a modern grid that adapts gracefully from desktop down to phone screens. I’m happy to discuss colour or type tweaks later, but the structure must come first.
Scope & key deliverables • An intuitive navigation map and wireframes that highlight primary fan actions (play, buy, subscribe). • High-fidelity mock-ups showing the redesigned layout on desktop, tablet and mobile. • Front-end build or theme implementation that keeps load times snappy and carries through the approved design. • Handoff documentation so future updates stay consistent with the new style.
Acceptance criteria Finished pages should load in under three seconds on 4G, the main CTA must be visible without scrolling on mobile, and all core journeys—stream a track, purchase a record, join the mailing list—should complete in three steps or fewer.
Share any relevant case studies or live sites where you’ve streamlined navigation for artists, and let’s create a site that feels as good to explore as the music sounds.

item.title: Bold MedTech Website & Landing Design
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I’m bringing a disruptive Class II orthopedic device for hip and knee replacement to market and already have the core assets in hand—brand guidelines, high-resolution photography, polished messaging, and all the technical copy. What I’m missing is a designer who can translate those ingredients into a modern, high-impact web presence that feels like a fast-moving startup, not a conservative healthcare conglomerate.
The visual language needs to be bold and dynamic, backed by a crystal-clear hierarchy that guides surgeons, hospital buyers, and potential partners straight to the information that matters most: our product benefits and the measurable value they deliver in the OR. Every screen should move visitors efficiently toward conversion, whether that’s downloading a spec sheet or initiating a deeper conversation with our team.
Deliverables • Responsive website design (desktop & mobile) showcasing the full product story • High-conversion landing page template(s) that spotlight key product benefits • Design files in Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD, ready for hand-off to development • Style specifications for typography, color, iconography, and imagery usage
Acceptance criteria • Visual hierarchy supports scanning and quick comprehension of benefits • Consistent, startup-worthy aesthetic with medical-grade credibility • All copy and images from our asset library integrated accurately • Pages load cleanly on standard breakpoints and meet WCAG AA color contrast
If you thrive on creating visually striking, conversion-focused experiences for innovative medical technologies, I’d love to see what you can do with our story.

item.title: Minimalist Tiling Store Website
item.description:
250-750 AUD | I’m setting up a small online shop focused on just five tiling-levelling products and I need a clean, modern, minimalist website to match. The site should feel light and uncluttered yet make it effortless for customers across Australia to select a product, read all the details, checkout and pay.
Core requirements • Design aesthetic: modern and minimalist, with plenty of white space and straightforward navigation. • Catalogue: only five products, each with a dedicated page that includes a zoomable image gallery, a detailed description and space for customer reviews. • Payments: integrate credit/debit card processing, PayPal and bank-transfer options so buyers can choose what suits them. • Mobile responsiveness and fast loading are essential.
I’ll provide product photos, copy and pricing. You’ll handle theme selection or custom build, checkout setup, basic SEO, and a quick walk-through so I can update stock or pricing myself later.
Acceptance will be based on: 1. All five products live and purchasable with the three payment methods fully tested. 2. Zoom feature, reviews section and description layout working on desktop and mobile. 3. Clean, minimalist look consistent across all pages.
If this sounds straightforward for you, let’s get it launched.

item.title: WordPress Property-Manager Portal Development
item.description:
250-750 AUD | I am looking for a WordPress developer to build a secure property-manager portal within my existing Mako Property Care website.
The aim is to provide real estate/property managers with a simple online portal where they can manage their properties and request maintenance services from Mako.
Existing Technology
The website is built on WordPress and I intend to use:
Gutenberg Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) Forminator or similar forms A lightweight custom WordPress plugin where required I want to avoid Elementor or a separate custom application unless there is a strong technical reason.
Core Portal Workflow
The main workflow should be:
Property Manager Login → My Properties → Select Property → Request a Job → Track Job → View Job Report/Photos/Documents
Main Features Required
1. Secure Property Manager Login
Individual property-manager accounts Property managers cannot access WordPress administration Each manager can only see their own assigned properties 2. My Properties
Display properties assigned to the logged-in manager Property cards showing photo, address, property ID and status “View Property” and “Request a Job” buttons Must be dynamically filtered by the logged-in user 3. Individual Property Page Each property should have:
Property information Access instructions Special instructions Request a Job Current Jobs Job Reports Photos Documents 4. Maintenance Request Form Using Forminator or similar:
Property — automatically selected Service required Description Priority Preferred date Photo upload Additional information Services will initially include lawn mowing, gutter cleaning, pressure washing, window cleaning, house washing, roof cleaning and other external property maintenance.
5. Jobs Property managers should be able to see:
Job number Property Service Status Requested/scheduled/completed dates Job details 6. Job Reports Mako staff should be able to upload reports containing:
Work completed Before/after condition Recommendations Before/after photos PDF report Property managers should only see reports belonging to their properties.
7. Documents Allow property-specific documents such as:
Quotes Invoices Job reports Certificates Photos Other documents Security
This is particularly important.
A property manager must not be able to access another manager’s property, job, report or document by changing a URL or otherwise bypassing the portal.
Access must be controlled at the server/WordPress level, not simply by hiding information from the screen.
Future Integration
The system should be designed so that we can later integrate with ServiceM8 or Formitize for job management, scheduling, reporting and other automation.
I do not require that integration in the initial build.
My Priority
I want a professional but simple and affordable MVP that I can manage myself after development.
I need to be able to:
Add a property → assign it to a property manager → publish → property automatically appears in that manager’s portal.
The portal must be mobile-friendly and work well on phones, tablets and desktop.
Initial Quote Request
Could you please provide:
Estimated development cost Estimated timeframe What plugins/licences you would require What you would recommend changing or simplifying Ongoing maintenance costs, if any Whether you can build the system so it can later integrate with ServiceM8 or Formitize

item.title: CEO Dashboard & WordPress Booking Revamp
item.description:
250-750 CAD | I need two tightly-connected pieces of work completed so I can run the business with better data and turn more site visitors into confirmed bookings.
1) CEO Profit-and-Loss Dashboard I want a single place where I can open my laptop each morning and see daily, weekly and monthly profit & loss, broken down by the specific Chart of Accounts we already use. Data has to flow automatically through Zapier from Square, Canadian QuickBooks Online, Payworks and Jobber. The mapping between each system and the COA needs to be built once and then monitored so nothing falls out of sync. I’m open on the display layer—Google Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI or even a well-structured Google Sheet—as long as it is live-updating, shareable and can be filtered quickly.
Key needs • Robust Zapier workflows (or direct API calls if you prefer) that pull sales, payroll and job data in near real time. • Clear COA mapping tables I can adjust myself. • Daily, weekly and monthly P&L views plus a simple drill-down on major expense categories. • A short Loom or Zoom walkthrough so I know how to maintain it.
2) WordPress Website Update The current WordPress site is staying, but it needs a refresh in design layout, functionality and content / SEO so more customers complete an online booking. I already use Jobber for service scheduling and Booqable for rentals; both widgets have to slot smoothly into the new pages, look native and work flawlessly on mobile.
Primary goals • Update the layout to modern, fast, mobile-first styling without breaking anything live. • Improve the booking flow: clearer calls-to-action, fewer clicks to Jobber/Booqable checkout, and obvious trust signals. • Rewrite or refine page copy, headings and meta so we rank better for local keywords. • Optimise page speed and core vitals after the changes.
Deliverables (acceptance criteria) • Working Zapier scenarios with documented steps. • Live dashboard link showing correct figures for at least the last 30 days. • Staging then live WordPress theme/files with new design, Jobber & Booqable embedded, and no layout issues on mobile, tablet or desktop. • On-page SEO checks passed (titles, H1s, alt tags, schema where useful). • A concise hand-off guide covering both the dashboard and the site.
If you’ve built financial dashboards and tuned WordPress funnels before, this should be a smooth project. Let me know your proposed stack and timeline and we can get started right away.

item.title: Members-Only WordPress Video Site
item.description:
250-750 USD | I am putting together a WordPress-based content site that showcases HD videos (and some supporting photo sets) exclusively to paying members. Access must be locked behind a strict paywall with four subscription lengths—1, 3, 6 and 12 months—processed through CCBill. No part of the library should be viewable or streamable until a valid subscription is active.
On top of streaming, I want visitors to be able to download each video either: • as a one-off single-purchase download, or • as part of an enhanced “download included” subscription tier charged at a higher price point.
Both options need to run through CCBill so the billing workflow stays seamless.
Key points you’ll tackle • Build or configure a secure membership plugin that supports CCBill’s recurring billing and lets me create multiple plan durations with flexible pricing. • Protect all media—videos and photos—so direct URLs can’t be shared. Cloud-friendly storage (e.g. Amazon S3 + expiring links) is preferred but I’m open to other proven methods. • Implement the dual download model (single purchase vs. subscription-based) and ensure each transaction updates the member’s permissions instantly. • Create a clean, mobile-first theme where browsing, streaming and purchasing feel friction-free.
Acceptance: A test account should confirm that (1) content is invisible when expired, (2) streaming works smoothly on desktop and mobile, (3) single-purchase files download only after payment, and (4) subscription upgrades/downgrades propagate correctly inside CCBill and on the site.
If you’ve integrated CCBill with WordPress memberships before, tell me which plugins or custom code you used so I know we can hit the ground running.

item.title: Brand Website With Contact Form
item.description:
25-50 USD/hr | I want a clean, desktop-first website that pulls my scattered online presence—Instagram, Facebook, and our Android/iPhone touchpoints—into one place. The assignment is design-only: I need layered source files (Figma, XD, or Sketch) that show how each screen looks and behaves.
The site is intentionally focused on desktop, so you don’t need to worry about mobile responsiveness. What matters is a modern layout, clear typography, and a friction-free contact form that lets visitors send messages straight to my inbox. Social icons pointing to our Instagram locations and Facebook page should sit prominently in the header or footer to keep the brand connection obvious.
Deliverables • Complete desktop website design, all pages and states • Fully designed contact form (fields, error states, confirmation) • Inclusion of Instagram and Facebook icons/links in the layout • Exported assets plus editable design file
Once the design meets those points, I’ll handle the development side.

item.title: Informational Website Design Needed
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I’m ready to move my idea from notes to screens and need a designer who can create a clean, modern look for a purely informational website. The job is design-only—no development—so your focus will be on layout, typography, colour, and user flow.
The site will not sell products or showcase a portfolio, it simply has to present information clearly and credibly. I have the page structure sketched out (home, about, services, contact, plus a blog index) and brand colours selected; you’ll translate those into wireframes and high-fidelity mock-ups that feel cohesive on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Please include links to past work that shows you’ve handled similar informational sites. I’ll use that to gauge your visual style and attention to detail. If we click, I’ll supply the copy, logo, and any imagery you need so you can jump straight into Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch—whichever you’re most comfortable using.
Final deliverables are the editable design files, export-ready assets, and a brief style guide so a developer can implement your work without endless back-and-forth. If this sounds straightforward and exciting, I’d love to hear from you.

item.title: Engaging Website Design for Hospitality Consultancy
item.description:
250-750 GBP | I am launching The Menu Method, a specialist consultancy helping restaurants, pubs and hospitality businesses improve the profitability of their menus through menu engineering, data analysis and practical commercial insight.
I have 10 years’ experience in hospitality marketing, working with businesses including PizzaExpress, Fuller, Smith & Turner and independent hospitality groups.
The website needs to establish The Menu Method as credible, knowledgeable and commercially focused, while still feeling approachable and personal.
What I’m looking for: I am looking for an experienced web designer/developer to create a clean, professional and modern website using an existing high-quality template or theme. The budget for the initial website is approximately £750, so I am not looking for a fully bespoke website design. I would like the designer to recommend an appropriate template/platform and customise it effectively using my branding, content, imagery and colours. The finished site should feel polished and professional rather than obviously "off the shelf". The overall style should be: • Sophisticated but not corporate • Modern and visually engaging • Clean and uncluttered • Commercial and professional • Approachable and personal • Appropriate for the hospitality industry
Website requirements: The initial website will be relatively small, with approximately 5–7 pages: • Home • About / Meet Anita • What I Do / Services • How It Works • FAQs • Insights / Blog • Contact
I will provide the majority of the written content. I would welcome some guidance on how the content should be structured within the chosen template.
Key objective: The primary purpose of the website is to generate enquiries from restaurant, pub and hospitality operators. Visitors should quickly understand: • What I do • Who I help • Why my experience makes me credible • What they can expect from working with me • How to get in touch The main message should be clear: I help hospitality businesses make more profit from their existing menus.
Design approach: I am happy to work from an existing premium template/theme rather than developing a completely bespoke design. I would like the designer to recommend a template that suits the business and then customise it appropriately. I'm particularly interested in: • Strong typography • High-quality food/hospitality imagery • Plenty of white space • A simple, sophisticated colour palette • Clear calls to action • Good visual hierarchy • Subtle animations where they are already supported by the chosen template
The site must work well on desktop, tablet and mobile.
The priority is making a well-chosen template feel polished, cohesive and appropriate for The Menu Method, rather than creating a completely bespoke design.
Functionality - The website should include: • Contact/enquiry form • Clear calls-to-action • Blog/Insights capability • Basic SEO setup • Google Analytics or equivalent tracking • Mobile optimisation • Fast-loading pages • Easy-to-manage CMS • Basic cookie/privacy functionality appropriate for a UK business
No complex bespoke functionality or integrations are required at this stage.
Branding: I have some initial ideas for The Menu Method's visual direction but do not currently require a full brand identity project.
I would like the website to establish a simple and professional visual identity through: • Typography • Colour palette • Image style • Layout • Consistent use of design elements
I am happy to use a relatively simple visual identity initially and develop the branding further as the business grows.
Platform / CMS I am open to recommendations but would prefer a straightforward platform that allows me to make basic content changes myself.
Please explain which platform you would recommend and why.
A suitable WordPress, Squarespace, Wix, Webflow or similar template-based solution would be considered.
What I'm looking for in a freelancer: Please only apply if you have experience creating professional websites using existing templates/themes.
I am particularly interested in someone who can: • Select an appropriate template rather than simply use the first available theme • Make a template feel polished and personalised • Have a good eye for typography, imagery and layout • Understand basic conversion principles • Work efficiently within a fixed budget • Communicate clearly and reliably • Make sensible recommendations where something could be improved
Hospitality, restaurant, food, lifestyle, consultancy or other premium service-sector experience would be useful but is not essential.
Budget: The budget for the initial website is approximately £750. I am specifically looking for a template-based solution to keep the initial investment manageable.
Please indicate clearly what is included within your price and identify any additional costs separately.
I am open to using a paid premium template/theme if this is appropriate, although any additional licence cost should be identified before proceeding. Please include with your proposal
Please provide: • 2–3 examples of relevant websites you have designed/built • The platform/CMS you would recommend • An example of the type of template/theme you might use • A brief explanation of your approach • Estimated timescale • Fixed project price • What is included in the price • Any costs that I would need to pay separately • Any ongoing hosting, software or licence costs
Please don't send a generic proposal. I'd particularly like to understand how you would approach creating a polished £750 website for The Menu Method using a suitable template.
There may be opportunities for further website, design and content work as the business develops, so I'm also interested in finding someone I can work with longer term.

item.title: Comprehensive Website Redesign and SEO
item.description:
250-750 AUD | Sorry please read over the below and quote based on it as a once off fee.
Project: Builder Website Rebuild + Ongoing Local SEO — Built by CC (https://builtbycc.com.au/)
I’m seeking an experienced website designer/developer to rebuild the website for my brother’s building business, Built by CC, servicing Port Macquarie and the Hastings region in NSW, Australia.
I built the current website myself. We now want a professional, visually appealing website that showcases the quality of his work, builds trust and generates relevant enquiries from local homeowners.
We’re open to working with an overseas freelancer or small team. Please quote the website build separately from optional ongoing local SEO and website maintenance.
DESIGN AND WEBSITE STRUCTURE
- Create a modern, polished design suitable for a quality residential building business. - Develop an original design for Built by CC, with strong photography, clear navigation and an excellent mobile experience. - Plan approximately 10–12 core pages, with the final structure agreed before work begins: - Homepage. - About Chris and the team. - Three or four service pages; exact services to be confirmed. - Projects overview. - Three individual project case studies. - Contact/enquiry page. - Include an easy-to-manage system so we can add projects, replace photographs and update text ourselves. - Recommend a suitable platform and explain why it fits our requirements, including ongoing costs. - Build in a plugin simialr to a different industry (www.nexgen.com.au) that someone can click 1) new build, renovation, extensions, outdoor living, 2) postcode 3) full name, email, phone number
PHOTOGRAPHY, VIDEO AND CONTENT
- We are arranging professional photography across three completed homes, plus team photographs. - We expect to supply approximately 60–80 edited photographs, one brand video and two client testimonial videos. - Photography and video production are not part of this job. - Select, arrange and optimise the supplied images for the website. - Integrate the videos without unnecessarily slowing down the site. - Create project case studies combining photographs, project details and client feedback. - Review our existing website content and identify what needs rewriting or adding. - Specify whether copywriting is included. If not, quote it separately. - Use clear Australian English and avoid generic or repetitive content.
ENQUIRIES AND USER EXPERIENCE
- Make it easy for visitors to understand our services, view relevant projects and contact us. - Include clear enquiry buttons and click-to-call links on mobile. - Build an enquiry form capturing name, contact details, project location, project type and a short description. - Include spam protection and test that enquiries reach our nominated email address. - Provide a clear confirmation after a form is submitted. - Follow accessibility basics, including readable text, colour contrast and labelled forms.
SEO INCLUDED IN THE WEBSITE BUILD
- Research relevant local search terms for our agreed services within Port Macquarie and the Hastings region. - Use the research to inform page structure, headings and content. - Configure page titles, meta descriptions, clean URLs, internal links and descriptive image alt text. - Optimise image sizes, loading performance and mobile usability. - Set up appropriate structured data, sitemap and indexing settings. - Set up or connect Google Analytics and Google Search Console under accounts we own. - Track successful enquiry submissions and phone-link clicks. - Review existing website URLs and implement redirects where addresses change. - Include a Google Business Profile review and recommendations, with any implementation clearly scoped.
OPTIONAL ONGOING LOCAL SEO — QUOTE SEPARATELY
Our target customers are in Port Macquarie and the Hastings region. We are not seeking a national SEO campaign.
Please propose a monthly service covering: - Local search and Google Business Profile improvements. - Ongoing service-page and project-content improvements. - A practical process for requesting genuine customer reviews. - Relevant business listings and legitimate local link opportunities. - Technical checks and fixes. - Monthly reporting on completed work, search performance and enquiries. - Recommendations based on attracting suitable building projects, rather than traffic alone.
Please specify the actual monthly deliverables, fees and any minimum contract term. Paid advertising management and advertising spend are outside the initial scope.
DELIVERY AND HANDOVER
